notes:
Fixes the P0 W3-DEC-ZDRSKILL flagged (w3-status.md, out of wave scope): a global plugin kill ran every affected org's skill removal under skillRetentionPosture(ctx), i.e. the platform service principal's own posture, not each affected org's, so a non-ZDR platform principal leaked ZDR orgs' skill text into skill_revisions during a platform-wide kill.
New skillRetentionPostureForOrg(ctx, orgID) in registry_apis.go trusts ctx's verified non-ZDR posture only when orgID equals the ctx principal's own org; any other org (only reachable via the global-kill loop) gets the same fail-safe content-free answer an unverified principal gets. plugin_children.go RemoveSkill now calls it with orgID instead of skillRetentionPosture(ctx).
Side effect (depth P2, accepted): a global kill is now content-free for every affected org, ZDR or not, since capability-core has no live per-org posture oracle to tell them apart without a new cross-plane lookup; the audit row (plugin id, digest, reason) is unaffected, only the full-text revision snapshot is skipped for that one event.
